root_cause: The authenticated entrepreneur intelligence endpoint starts ten PostgREST requests in parallel. During the production 504 window Supabase recorded repeated statement timeouts, cron job startup failures and an overloaded multi-process runtime scheduler. No evidence justified converting failed queries into empty success data.
prevention_rule: Only launch lazy PostgREST queries in batches of at most three. Preserve all ten reads, original order, existing tenant filters and strict fail-closed behavior. Any database read error must still return HTTP 500/502/503, never a success-shaped false proof. Avoid disabling unrelated schedulers.

evidence.databaseObservation: SQL statement timeouts at 16:08–16:13Z, job 171 longest ~722 seconds; 10 simultaneous portal database reads
